feeds.title: Little House Big Alaska
feeds.description: Laura Sampson is on a mission to teach modern family oriented women how to make old-fashioned foods new again. A wife and mom of 3 boys, Laura understands the struggles of trying to serve a home-cooked meal each night. She provides recipes and cooking hacks for busy moms to create dishes they may think to take more time or skill than they have to make.

feeds.title: Coleen's Recipes Blog
feeds.description: A blog on tried and true, old fashioned, family style recipes from Coleens kitchen in Alaska.

feeds.title: Allergy Free Alaska Blog
feeds.description: Hey, I'm Megan. Wife, mother, and gluten-free baker of 12+ years. Here you'll find my tasty from-scratch recipes that are always gluten-free and dairy-free, with some vegan and grain-free, too.

feeds.title: Sandra's Alaska Recipes Blog
feeds.description: Newly created recipes and traditional favorites featuring wild Alaska salmon, seafood, venison. moose and waterfowl.

feeds.title: Alaska Magazine » Alaskan Food
feeds.description: Great stories, photography, videos and food recipes at Alaska Magazine. They have been sharing authentic Alaska since 1935. Today's Alaska is a vibrant and multifaceted place, and guide you on adventures large and small while you explore life on the Last Frontier through images and stories by award-winning photographers and writers.
